function.name: get_order
function.description: Look up an order by id

messages.content: You are a customer-support agent for an online shop. Verify the order before acting.
Hi, can you cancel my order #W1000? I ordered by mistake.
{"order_id": "#W1000", "status": "pending", "items": ["Desk lamp"]}
Order #W1000 (Desk lamp) is pending. Shall I cancel it with the reason 'ordered by mistake'?
Yes please.
{"order_id": "#W1000", "status": "cancelled"}
Done: order #W1000 is cancelled. The refund goes back to your original payment method.
